hotContext.criticalNews: Denmark became fourth European country to approve FSD on June 9, 2026. EU-wide recognition anticipated summer 2026 via mutual recognition process.

sentiment.headline: positive
sentiment.rationale: Denmark approval represents fourth European country and demonstrates continued FSD expansion momentum in region.

positive_signals: Denmark became fourth European country with FSD approval on June 9
Netherlands granted first EU approval April 10, 2026
EU-wide recognition anticipated summer 2026 via mutual recognition
negative_signals: EU-wide timeline is Tesla's projection, not confirmed regulatory outcome
Each country still requires individual activation despite mutual recognition pathway

key_metrics.actual: 4 European countries approved (NL, LT, EE, DK)

recentKeyChanges.title: Denmark becomes fourth European country to approve FSD on June 9
recentKeyChanges.description: Denmark greenlit Tesla FSD Supervised on June 9, 2026, following Netherlands (April 10), Lithuania (May 20), and Estonia (May 29). The Dutch vehicle authority RDW granted the first European type approval, and Tesla anticipates EU-wide recognition during summer 2026 through mutual recognition, potentially extending access to Germany, France, and other major markets without repeating the full 18-month review process. Tesla now has FSD Supervised available in 12 countries globally.

sentiment.headline: positive
sentiment.rationale: Official confirmation of voice-taught contextual FSD and a September Grok→planning timeline is progress, but it is a roadmap commitment — not a shipped capability yet.

positive_signals: Ashok Elluswamy confirmed voice-taught, remembered contextual FSD instructions (July 8)
Musk: Grok voice commands to FSD planning layer targeted by September 2026
Directly improves last-100-feet robotaxi pickup/dropoff quality at scale
negative_signals: Feature not shipped yet — testing burden for safety (e.g. refusing unsafe commands)
September timeline is guidance, not a release

key_metrics.actual: Confirmed on roadmap; Grok in-car exists but has no FSD authority today
key_metrics.target: Grok voice → FSD planning by September 2026

recentKeyChanges.title: Tesla confirms voice-taught FSD context; Grok→planning by September
recentKeyChanges.description: On July 8, 2026, Tesla VP of AI Software Ashok Elluswamy confirmed Tesla is building a feature that lets drivers teach the car hyper-local context in plain language (e.g. which driveway) with the instruction remembered for future trips. Elon Musk separately confirmed Grok voice commands will pass into FSD's planning layer by September 2026. This is infrastructure for both consumer FSD and robotaxi last-mile pickup quality, but remains unreleased pending safety testing.
